title: Affiliate Disclosure
paragraphs: VibePress Studio believes in full transparency on the web. We are disclosing that we've included certain products and links to those products on this site that we will earn an affiliate commission for any purchases you make.

Our goal with the blog and resources is to help educate you on the possibilities that exist in the software engineering and WordPress ecosystems, but please understand we are doing this as a for-profit business.

section.heading: AppSumo & Third-Party Marketplaces
section.body: When you click a link to AppSumo or Freemius from our site, it may contain an affiliate or tracking parameter. This helps support our development at no extra cost to you.
